HOW IT WORKS

A sourcing brief that is easier to compare.

01

Send the brief

Tell us what you need, where it is going and when it is needed. Drawings and specifications help.

02

We price the whole trip

We bring each option back to a consistent AUD delivered-cost scope, instead of stopping at a factory number.

03

Choose with context

Receive up to three quotes side by side, with inclusions, exclusions and assumptions clearly called out.

GLASS FIRST

Better glass.
A clearer price.

Quality and affordability start with understanding what you are comparing.

  1. 01

    Start with the glass.

    Our comparison target starts with a 6 mm Low-E pane; the coating specification and supplier evidence still need to match.

  2. 02

    Look beyond one pane.

    A 12 mm cavity and a second 6 mm toughened pane complete the target glazing build-up; confirm the actual unit and whole-window performance.

  3. 03

    Compare quality. Then cost.

    Check the specification, test evidence and warranty alongside the full delivered price in AUD—not just the cheapest starting number.

Quality first. Then compare the full cost.

Ask each supplier for the exact glass make-up, Low-E coating, toughening, whole-window performance data, test evidence and warranty. A shared 6 / 12 / 6 description does not establish equal quality or suitability for your project.

Online sources checked 24 Sep 2026. AUD conversions use RBA rates dated 23 Sep 2026: 0.7102 USD and 23.57 THB per AUD, excluding bank spreads and fees. Thailand’s guide is rounded to whole AUD per m²; China’s price includes door-to-door shipping per the team’s clarification. Country order is not a price or quality ranking.
